scope_notes: GC manifest has four accepted replacement spans backed by three distinct AUnit cases; gengc has no separate source replacement manifest in this mapping. Parameter mapping includes additional production behavior and codec cases.
Source registration and historical OK-label occurrence are evidence-discovery facts only; they establish no final-context or source-revision acceptance.

Replay each required case in every applicable configured AUnit job, including default jobs where private test package directly registers adapter tests; production T availability does not determine test-suite registration.
capture_gaps: Shared capture now retains stdout/stderr hashes, executable and test-source hashes, library hashes, revision/dirty flag, configuration/profile/library/platform metadata, completion and exit status, plus a compiled-configuration sibling probe. This source observation is not an executed final-context pass.
The capture checks aggregate suite footer and expected stderr; per-case replay must still require each of the required exact registered OK labels once and reject missing/duplicate labels.

Final-context replay must bind captures to expected immutable revision/source/executable/library identities and compare the compiled configuration probe, rather than trusting command arguments. Root separately reviews configuration and provenance enforcement.
Historical logs retain historical provenance; they cannot satisfy newly added Minor_Multiplier_Debt or final-revision obligations.
AUnit cleanup assertions complement but do not replace selected whole-file allocator/shutdown telemetry.
historical_capture_gaps: Default check.ps1 invokes test_runner through Alire and only forwards console output; no dedicated AUnit stdout/stderr/process metadata capture is retained by that step. CI logs can be independently downloaded, but current artifacts alone lack this per-case stream.

Instrumented check-instrumented.ps1 retains aunit.stdout/stderr and aggregate completion/exit status plus a library-artifact hash. Its observation does not bind test_runner executable hash, source/revision hashes, stdout/stderr hashes, unique context/run identity or required individual labels.
Aggregate zero-failure counts are insufficient if required cases are unregistered or replaced. Match exact full OK lines once each, check complete footer/exit/expected stderr and all required labels.
Minor_Multiplier_Debt is newly added; historical CI captures predating it cannot satisfy its replay obligation.
Per-case replay must be bound to final revision, test source hashes, executable/library hashes, profile/library/configuration/platform context and retained process captures.
AUnit physical cleanup assertions complement but do not replace selected whole-file allocator/shutdown telemetry.

observations: Default and instrumented entrypoints now invoke the shared evidence capture.
Unique retained result directory and hashed AUnit streams provide named-case replay inputs for both configurations.
Actual executable path and sibling compiled-configuration probe are checked; probe bytes and executable hash are retained.
Test source and library artifact hashes, process status and expected diagnostic checks improve provenance; root owns remaining enforcement review.

immutable_library_delta.observation: Runtime-producing builds explicitly select PREBUILT=false. Default CLI and AUnit consumers select PREBUILT=true after the owning build. Both core-image consumer runs select UseExistingRuntime to preserve the measured runtime artifact.

physical_replay_delta.scope: Physical mechanisms supplement source-specific assertions and timed process closure. All labels must occur once in actual complete AUnit output.
